method: Actual Scene meshes and actual Screen/result component hosts at authored fixed state/pose. useFrame sampled at delta0. Native Canvas/ready/audio are stubbed; CSS is not native Yoga. These still fixtures do not prove controller routes, saves, device frame timing or user perception.

Armed fixture was canceled by actual Screen mount cleanup. Harness now performs real post-mount enter-projector then reads current controller state; all fixture state and controls visibility are asserted. Both revisions recaptured.
Solved lamp comparison now uses the same initial observation pose so optional vs unresolved target labels actually appear.
Running fixture uses seconds=3,cooldown=4.2 to match real simultaneous countdown, on both revisions.
Shelf-edge comparison was aimed into the actual shelf opening before final paired capture.
A draft capture failed the source-change guard during authorized final UI edits; discarded in favor of frozen-source captures.
